item.title: Bulletin updated at 18:35 HKT 25/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to affect southern China tomorrow. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds will cover the northern part of the South China Sea and Guangdong. A dry replenishment of the monsoon will reach the coast of southern China on Friday. It will become cool again over the region during the weekend, and the weather will improve. With the monsoon moderating early next week, temperatures over Guangdong will rise slightly.
